title: Weak suction cups, not great in shower, but perfect for barn storage use.
text:
Weak suction cups, not great in shower, but perfect for barn storage use.. This is meant for the shower and while the mesh material is appropriate for a wet environment, the suction cups are weak. My unit holds fine as long as it is empty. The problem starts when I put stuff in it....you know, when I try to actually use it to hold things in the shower. The suction cups just slide down the glass or worse, pop off entirely and send the whole thing flying.

So, I have repurposed this for use in my horse barn. Hanging on a stall door it works pretty well to hold things like hoof picks, mane brushes, random rags and treat bags. The water friendly mesh can be hosed off to clean and dries quickly.

description: DII Mesh Laundry Hamper and Organizers are perfect for everyone in the home. Our laundry hamper is the perfect hamper for your household or to bring to a dorm. With convenient suction cups to stay in place just about anywhere in your home.
